message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Defendant Hou Moumou (侯某某) for personal use, in August 2013 and August 15, 2014, in Dunhua Forestry Bureau Liushu River forest area 20 forest class, his contracted frog breeding ditch, used a sickle to illegally destroy two trees of a nationally protected plant water willow (Salix babylonica? Actually water curve willow) with diameter 2 cm. So illegal destruction of a nationally protected plant. The list includes "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物" as a charge. Indeed there is a label: "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物". That matches.

Thus single charge: [罪名]非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物<eoa>
